title: Diploma In People And Organisations (Level 3)
description: Gain essential knowledge and practical skills to understand and support effective people and organisational management.
longDescription: This Level 3 Diploma explores the foundational principles of managing people and organisations in today’s dynamic work environment. It covers human resources, leadership, team collaboration, professional development, and organisational planning. Learners will engage with real-world case studies, group discussions, and workplace-relevant challenges to build confidence and competence. The programme also focuses on improving self-awareness, decision-making, and communication strategies vital for career growth.
courseDetails: The course blends theory and practice to help learners understand how organisations operate, how people are managed, and how to align personal goals with organisational values. Designed for those entering supervisory roles or looking to upskill, the programme encourages reflection, teamwork, and planning within business contexts. It’s ideal for aspiring team leaders, HR assistants, and junior managers across sectors.

entry: There are no formal entry requirements for this qualification.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

outcomes: Explain the role of HR in workforce planning, recruitment, and employee development.
Discuss employment legislation and its impact on people management.
Analyse the qualities of effective leadership and different leadership styles in various scenarios.
Apply management techniques to improve team performance and motivation.
Describe how organisational structure affects communication, efficiency, and employee satisfaction.
Explore the influence of organisational culture and values on individual and team behaviour.
Set personal goals and create development plans based on self-assessment and feedback.
Evaluate learning opportunities that support both personal and career progression.
Describe the stages of organisational planning and how they support long-term goals.
Demonstrate an understanding of teamwork principles, including collaboration, conflict resolution, and shared responsibilities.
